description: This file contains utility functions and classes for converting PyTorch nn.Module models into functional forms, supporting parameter and buffer extraction, reloading, and ensemble operations, primarily for use with functorch.

classes.name: FunctionalModuleWithBuffers
classes.description: A callable module that applies a functional version of a model with buffers, allowing parameter and buffer updates.

classes.name: FunctionalModule
classes.description: A callable module that applies a functional version of a model with parameters.

methods.name: raise_parameter_tying_error
methods.description: Raises an error indicating that parameter tying (weight sharing) is not supported.

methods.name: create_names_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from parameter names to tied parameter names, handling duplicates.

methods.name: _extract_members
methods.description: Extracts parameters or buffers from a model, replacing them with dummy tensors.

methods.name: extract_weights
methods.description: Extracts all parameters from a model, removing them from the model.

methods.name: extract_buffers
methods.description: Extracts all buffers from a model, removing them from the model.

methods.name: load_weights
methods.description: Loads a set of weights into a model, optionally as parameters.

methods.name: _swap_state
methods.description: Swaps the model's parameters and buffers with new tensors, returning the old state.

methods.name: load_state
methods.description: Loads weights and buffers into a model, restoring its state.

methods.name: make_functional_deprecated_v1
methods.description: Converts a model into a functional form, extracting weights and returning a callable.

methods.name: make_functional_with_buffers_deprecated_v1
methods.description: Converts a model into a functional form including buffers, returning weights, buffers, and a callable.

methods.name: FunctionalModuleWithBuffers
methods.description: A class representing a functional module with buffers, supporting forward pass with parameter and buffer updates.

methods.name: FunctionalModule
methods.description: A class representing a functional module with parameters, supporting forward pass with parameter updates.

methods.name: make_functional
methods.description: Creates a functional version of a model, extracting parameters.

methods.name: make_functional_with_buffers
methods.description: Creates a functional version of a model, extracting parameters and buffers.

methods.name: transpose_stack
methods.description: Stacks and transposes a tuple of tuples of tensors.

methods.name: combine_state_for_ensemble
methods.description: Stacks parameters and buffers from multiple models for ensemble use.

methods.name: functional_init
methods.description: Initializes a functional model or ensemble of models.

methods.name: functional_init_with_buffers
methods.description: Initializes a functional model or ensemble of models including buffers.
